# Raising the inheritor

<!-- generated by `python levels.py --markdown LEVELS.md` - do not edit -->

Diamonds from inheritor level 1 to 9, starting with no relics. 5,000 diamonds buys 11 random relics of 12 types; an attempt uses 10 of one type. A level is reached by its quest or by a full pity meter, whichever comes first.

dmg increase = (1 + level multiplier) x (1 + 4/5 x crit amp) x (1 + 22/209 x atk amp) - 1, where the level multiplier is +5% a level for levels 2-7 and +10% for 8 and 9. Marginal columns are relative to the level before.

## Greedy mode

Every level-up made as cheap as it can be on its own, ignoring later levels. 20,000 simulations.

## Strategy at each level

On every step, both modes: attempt as soon as any relic the quest needs is affordable; use whichever needed relic you hold the most of; keep a result only if it helps.

### Level 2 - Giant's Right Hand: 3+ / any

- **Greedy:** roll Giant's Right Hand to 3+ / any. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 500 pity (5 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll Giant's Right Hand to 3+ / any. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, summon. 500 pity (5 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.

### Level 3 - Demon Eye of Weakness, Oath of Immortality: 3+ / 2-

- **Greedy:** roll Demon Eye of Weakness, Oath of Immortality to 3+ / 2-. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 1,000 pity (10 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll Demon Eye of Weakness, Oath of Immortality to 3+ / 2-. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, summon. 1,000 pity (10 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.

### Level 4 - all twelve together: 25+ / 21- (totals)

- **Greedy:** roll whichever relics you hold the most of to 5+ / 1- until the totals clear; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, summon. 1,500 pity (15 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll whichever relics you hold the most of to 5+ / 1- until the totals clear; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, summon. 1,500 pity (15 attempts at +100) levels up without the quest.

### Level 5 - Sacred Tree of Rebirth, Ring of Lightning, Golden Star: 5+ / 2-

- **Greedy:** roll Sacred Tree of Rebirth, Ring of Lightning, Golden Star to 5+ / 2-. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 2,000 pity (17 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll Sacred Tree of Rebirth, Ring of Lightning, Golden Star to 5+ / 2-. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 2,000 pity (17 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.

### Level 6 - all twelve together: 44+ / 18- (totals)

- **Greedy:** roll whichever relics you hold the most of to 5+ / 1- until the totals clear; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 2,500 pity (21 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll whichever relics you hold the most of to 5+ / 1- until the totals clear; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 2,500 pity (21 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.

### Level 7 - every relic: 4+ / 2-

- **Greedy:** roll every relic that is short to 4+ / 2-; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 3,000 pity (25 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll every relic that is short to 4+ / 2-; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, summon. 3,000 pity (25 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.

### Level 8 - all twelve together: 59+ / 17- (totals)

- **Greedy:** repair, do not rebuild: using whichever relics you hold the most of, shave one despair off the worst relics until the total fits, then add one glory at a time; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 1-. 3,500 pity (30 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** repair, do not rebuild: using whichever relics you hold the most of, except Seal of the Legendary Archer, Veil of the Night, Spark of Eternity, shave one despair off the worst relics until the total fits, then add one glory at a time; play each attempt for max glory and min despair, weighted equally, not all-or-nothing for the bar; take any roll that closes the gap, even if it is not better on both bars (their stock is banked for level 9). When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic (never Seal of the Legendary Archer, Veil of the Night, Spark of Eternity) instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 1-. 3,500 pity (30 attempts at +120) levels up without the quest.

### Level 9 - Seal of the Legendary Archer, Veil of the Night, Spark of Eternity: 6+ / 2-

- **Greedy:** roll Seal of the Legendary Archer, Veil of the Night, Spark of Eternity to 6+ / 2-. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 4,000 pity (29 attempts at +140) levels up without the quest.
- **Look-ahead:** roll Seal of the Legendary Archer, Veil of the Night, Spark of Eternity to 6+ / 2-, paid for partly out of their stock banked during level 8. When nothing the quest needs is affordable, attempt the best-stocked spare relic instead of summoning, rolled for max glory + min despair and kept if it moves toward 4+ / 2-. 4,000 pity (29 attempts at +140) levels up without the quest.
